# has celestial coordinates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-hasCelestialCoordinates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCelestialCoordinates>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a celestial location to its equatorial or other sky coordinates.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) -> [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasCelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-hasCelestialCoordinates.md) from [`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) to [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CelestialLocation`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialLocation.md), [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach equatorial or other sky coordinates to a celestial location.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for terrestrial coordinates (use [`gmeow:hasCoordinates`](gmeow-hasCoordinates.md)) and avoid attaching coordinates without a declared celestial frame on the [`CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:hasCelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-hasCelestialCoordinates.md) at a [`CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) instance carrying [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) and [`gmeow:celestialEpoch`](gmeow-celestialEpoch.md).

### Examples

- ex:vega [`gmeow:hasCelestialCoordinates`](gmeow-hasCelestialCoordinates.md) ex:vegaCoords.
